heading: Wednesday, May 20, 2026
topLine: OpenAI model disproves Erdős's 1946 planar unit distance conjecture. Also: Alibaba unveils Qwen3.7-Max agent model.

items.headline: OpenAI model disproves Erdős's 1946 planar unit distance conjecture
items.summary: OpenAI said a general-purpose internal reasoning model produced point sets with more unit distances than the square-grid bound Erdős conjectured was optimal (Erdős problem #90). The gain is polynomial but very small. Nine outside mathematicians, including Noga Alon, Tim Gowers, Will Sawin and Melanie Matchett Wood, published a condensed, human-verified version of the construction and linked its ideas to earlier work in number theory. The companion paper is an arXiv preprint. Gowers called it a milestone for AI in mathematics.

items.headline: Alibaba unveils Qwen3.7-Max agent model
items.summary: Qwen3.7-Max is Alibaba's flagship model for agentic coding, complex reasoning and long-horizon tasks, announced with new chips and servers at its cloud summit. Alibaba says it can run autonomously for up to 35 hours and over 1,000 tool calls; API access was said to be coming soon.
